name: MiniMax M3
weights: open (MiniMax Community License: free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a 'Built with MiniMax M3' notice and either a one-time notice to MiniMax or, above US$20M yearly revenue, prior written authorization; an appendix lists prohibited uses, including military use)
access: MiniMax API platform (platform.minimax.io, Anthropic-compatible, OpenAI Chat Completions and OpenAI Responses endpoints, pay as you go)
Token Plan subscription (closed to new purchases; existing subscribers keep it)
Hugging Face weights (BF16 and MXFP8 checkpoints; MiniMax documents SGLang self-hosting as experimental)

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Standard tier up to 512K input tokens; above 512K it is 0.60 input, 2.40 output, 0.12 cached. The pricing page shows these as already discounted ('permanent 50% off'; list 0.60/2.40/0.12 and 1.20/4.80/0.24). Priority tier is 1.5x. Artificial Analysis lists the same 0.30 and 1.20. OpenRouter lists the same 0.30 and 1.20, a 1,048,576-token context and 512,000 output tokens.

unknown: reasoning default: depends on the endpoint. Omitting thinking leaves it off on the Anthropic-compatible endpoint and on the Responses endpoint, and enabled on the OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint (MiniMax's reference says adaptive is the default there)
SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no MiniMax row on Scale's leaderboard page (page source searched 2026-10-03)
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: no MiniMax entry among the 31 agent-and-model rows on the page (page data read 2026-10-03)
METR 50% time horizon: no MiniMax model on METR's time-horizons page (page source searched 2026-10-03)
Terminal-Bench 4.0 on the official tbench.ai leaderboard: no MiniMax row in the board data read on 2026-10-03; the value is from Artificial Analysis
Harness setting: the maker's benchmark rows do not state the thinking mode used
max_output: the number is the maximum of max_completion_tokens in MiniMax's OpenAI-compatible reference (recommended 131072); OpenRouter lists 512000; no other source names an output cap
context_window: the M3 page says the API supports up to 1M tokens with a guaranteed minimum of 512K; OpenRouter lists 1,048,576

prompting_guides: MiniMax publishes no prompting guide for M3; the earlier cited best-practices page (platform.minimax.io/docs/token-plan/prompting-best-practices) returns 404 and no replacement was found; the entries listed are tool-use, agent and caching guides
system_card: MiniMax publishes no system card or safety report for M3; the technical-report link on the Hugging Face card is the sparse-attention paper (arXiv 2606.13392), which has no safety section
safety evaluations: no published refusal, over-refusal, sycophancy, prompt-injection or classifier results found
OSWorld-Verified: the launch post's method note gives 70.06% (200 steps) while the Hugging Face card's image shows 75.2; both are recorded and MiniMax does not reconcile them
